free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.

retention.stated: We keep at least three copies, one of them off-site, at all times
retention.notes: The FAQ states the repository keeps at least three copies, one of them off-site, at all times.

egress.terms: You can download data and tools with a license that allows free sharing without any obstacles.

tooling: DSpace REST/OAI-PMH plus a documented submission workflow (repository/mydspace); handles as PIDs; SWORD-style deposit contract per collection ('Distribution License Agreement'). CLARIN SPF / eduGAIN SSO, and a local account on request.
chaining: Unlimited items per depositor x no per-item byte cap. Multiple CLARIN centres (LINDAT, CLARIN.SI, CLARIN-D, plus 20+ national nodes) each run their own DSpace with the same open door, so the chain is 'one account per centre'.

limits.value: Only authenticated users can deposit items.

limits_note: Account is the gate, not bytes: you need an eduGAIN institutional login, a CLARIN account, or a manually granted local account. Files >2 GB need help-desk handling. Every deposit signs a Distribution License Agreement and must carry adequate metadata, so bulk dumping of undocumented blobs will be rejected.
reliability_note: Run by UFAL with an explicit preservation policy since 2010; stable, but the metadata/contract review and the >2 GB manual step make it a scripted-assisted path rather than a fire-and-forget API.

extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: Deposit is free with no published byte ceiling ('It is free and safe'); the only stated object limit is operational — CLARIN-family DSpace instances handle files above 2 GB by special arrangement rather than refusing them. Individual deposited corpora routinely run to tens of GB.
extras.limits_verbatim: Account is the gate, not bytes: you need an eduGAIN institutional login, a CLARIN account, or a manually granted local account. Files >2 GB need help-desk handling. Every deposit signs a Distribution License Agreement and must carry adequate metadata, so bulk dumping of undocumented blobs will be rejected.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free. Public items download without login when the licence permits; licence-gated items need an account and an e-signed licence. No metering, no egress pricing — this is a national research-infrastructure node.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited items per depositor x no per-item byte cap. Multiple CLARIN centres (LINDAT, CLARIN.SI, CLARIN-D, plus 20+ national nodes) each run their own DSpace with the same open door, so the chain is 'one account per centre'.
extras.tooling_verbatim: DSpace REST/OAI-PMH plus a documented submission workflow (repository/mydspace); handles as PIDs; SWORD-style deposit contract per collection ('Distribution License Agreement'). CLARIN SPF / eduGAIN SSO, and a local account on request.
extras.agent_focus: Exotic and institutional surfaces: national libraries/archives, museum and heritage platforms, genomics/biobank consortia, audiovisual archives, government open-data portals, institutional repositories (DSpace/EPrints/Dataverse/Invenio) that accept EXTERNAL depositors, publishing platforms, religious/cultural bulk corpora. Priority seam: a university or national repository whose deposit door is open to anyone and whose write path is an API.

binding_note: the write is a queue with a person or a rule in it, so the upload rate is set by somebody else
